codes.evidence_quote: ¿Cómo se puede cantar tan bien, tan a compás y tan en su sitio? Aunabas en tu decir dos cosas que siempre han sido distintas: el cante para bailar y para escuchar
codes.target: Chano Lobato's singing and stage performance
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly praises Chano's quality, compás, placement, and ability to combine cante for dance and listening.

codes.evidence_quote: abriendo nuevos caminos que no están reñidos con la tradición porque tú conviviste con Aurelio, Pericón, Manolo Vargas y tantos otros; y al darle tu impronta nueva los revitalizas
codes.target: Chano Lobato's renewal of Cádiz cante
codes.rationale: Innovation is authorized through continuity with named past masters and framed as revitalizing inherited tradition.

codes.evidence_quote: tu compás milimétrico... produce una mayor comunicación con los públicos
codes.target: Chano Lobato's compás and communicative performance style
codes.rationale: Compás is used as an aesthetic criterion explaining the value and communicative force of Chano's cante.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The reference to conferences and illustration is not enough to make learning or access the central discourse function.

derived_analysis.target: Chano Lobato as performer and renovator of Cádiz cante

annotation_notes: The letter is highly laudatory; codes are limited to the clearest evaluative and tradition-continuity claims.

codes.evidence_quote: Ha heredado la musicalidad y la creatividad de los grandes maestros de la escuela de Cádiz y, por eso, su cante surge alimentado por la savia que le aportan unas raíces que se hunden en la esencia misma de la gaditanía.
codes.rationale: The passage grounds Chano's value in inheritance from Cádiz masters and in deep local roots.

codes.evidence_quote: Hoy él es lo que ayer fueran Aurelio y Manolo Vargas: el depositario de la más antigua cultura festera y cantaora del mundo.
codes.target: Chano Lobato within the Cádiz flamenco lineage
codes.rationale: Chano is canonized by comparison to earlier exemplary figures and positioned as the present depositary of a tradition.

codes.evidence_quote: es un aficionado cabal y un estudioso del cante. Despierta, lúcido, está siempre dispuesto a aprender cante y de cante, porque sólo los que mucho saben, valoran los saberes y siguen siempre aprendiendo. Y Chano es sabio.
codes.rationale: The text legitimates Chano as a knowledgeable student and possessor of flamenco saber, giving him authority as a learned practitioner.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: Although 'puro' and 'flamencura' appear, the stronger function is tradition-continuity and critical canonization rather than a distinct authenticity claim.

derived_analysis.target: Chano Lobato as embodiment of Cádiz cante

annotation_notes: Strong lineage and canon language; pedagogy is included only as knowledge-authority rather than formal teaching.

codes.evidence_quote: demostrándonos su valía, sapiencia y conocimientos
codes.rationale: The article repeatedly evaluates Chano's performances and explicitly praises his worth, knowledge, and artistry.

codes.evidence_quote: demostrándonos una vez más su maestría en dichas formas interpretativas
codes.target: Chano Lobato's interpretation of Cádiz styles
codes.rationale: Maestría in interpretive forms is used as an aesthetic criterion for judging the quality of Chano's cante.

codes.evidence_quote: donde comunicó perfectamente con los muchísimos aficionados asistentes
codes.target: Chano Lobato's relation with flamenco aficionados
codes.rationale: The passage values Chano's performance through successful communication with a community of aficionados.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The Compás del Cante award is mentioned, but the visible text does not frame it as heritage authorization or public cultural policy.

derived_analysis.target: Chano Lobato's remembered performances and community esteem

annotation_notes: Mostly a memory-piece with praise; institutional/event references are not coded unless they perform clear authorization.

codes.evidence_quote: nadie, nunca, había manifestado su cante con tanto sentido de la medida, del ritmo; en definitiva: me identifiqué con su salero y compás.
codes.rationale: Compás, measure, and rhythm are explicitly applied as aesthetic criteria for Chano's artistic value.

codes.evidence_quote: una larguísima etapa de vivir en los tablaos, de cantaor de atrás, donde está la escuela del compás y de la reiteración
codes.target: Chano Lobato's formation as a cantaor de atrás
codes.rationale: The text frames Chano's compás as learned through embodied repetition in tablao practice, an oral/performative transmission setting.

codes.evidence_quote: Chano Lobato es la expresión viva hoy de lo que representa ser un maestro de nuestro arte... si esto no es ser un verdadero maestro del flamenco —bien, Chano—, que venga Dios y lo vea.
codes.target: Chano Lobato as a flamenco master
codes.rationale: The article canonizes Chano as an exemplary living master and ranks him as a representative figure of the art.

codes.evidence_quote: Una grabación aderezada a veces con un organo eléctrico que, a mi entender desvirtuaba el flamenquismo con que Chano Lobato y Manolo Domínguez impregnaban en cada canción cante.
codes.target: electric-organ additions to Chano Lobato and Manolo Domínguez's recording
codes.rationale: The author polices a boundary by criticizing the electric organ as distorting the flamenquismo of the recording.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The payo/gitano comparison is mentioned as a contradiction around compás, but the passage does not develop identity as a stable authority framework.

derived_analysis.target: Chano Lobato's compás, professional authority, and recording aesthetics

annotation_notes: The article combines praise of Chano with a specific boundary critique of recording instrumentation.

codes.evidence_quote: Su actuación... estuvo sembrada de sabor y saber. Genuino representante de la mejor escuela del cante gaditano
codes.target: Chano Lobato's performance and Cádiz cante
codes.rationale: The author gives an explicit positive review of Chano's performance and artistic status.

codes.evidence_quote: No se puede cantar más a compás, con mayor gusto y gracia.
codes.target: Chano Lobato's compás, taste, and grace
codes.rationale: Compás, gusto, and gracia are applied as aesthetic criteria for evaluating flamenco quality.

codes.evidence_quote: Sin perder nunca las lindes del cante, sabe traspasarlas y seguir siendo genuino y verdadero por los atributos de su sapiencia, de su maestría.
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly attributes genuineness and truth to Chano's cante despite innovation beyond ordinary boundaries.

codes.evidence_quote: Genuino representante de la mejor escuela del cante gaditano
codes.target: Chano Lobato within the Cádiz school of cante
codes.rationale: Chano is positioned as an exemplary representative of a ranked 'best' school of Cádiz cante.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The audience response and communication are important to the review, but the text does not clearly contrast participatory/private versus spectatorial/public settings.

derived_analysis.target: Chano Lobato as singular, genuine representative of Cádiz cante

annotation_notes: Dense evaluative review; four codes retained because they represent distinct evaluation, criteria, authenticity, and canon functions.
